newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SPRING/WHITE WHEAT - SPRING WHEAT MOSTLY DOWN.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SPRING/WHITE WHEAT - SPRING WHEAT MOSTLY DOWN.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly lower Wednesday in response to modest losses on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, dealers said.
"We're just a little lower in line with the futures," said on Minnesota dealer.
MGE wheat ended three to 1-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with September down three at $3.91-1/4 and December down three at $3.94-1/4.
One dealer in central Montana said winter wheat in that area was 60 to 70 percent harvested and spring wheat was only four to five percent harvested.
"We've had just enough rain every day to slow harvest down a little bit," the dealer said.

On Wednesday, the Commodity Credit Corporation said it was seeking up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. spring wheat for shipment to Nicaragua November 1-20. The CCC also bought 30,000 tonnes of soft white wheat for Pakistan for shipment during November.
